items: How much is the new patient check-up?
Your new patient dental check-up is £50, usually £76.70. It includes a detailed dental examination, digital X-rays where required, a complimentary 3D digital scan and a personalised care plan.
What happens at my first appointment?
We carry out a full assessment of your teeth, gums and overall oral health, explain our findings clearly and discuss any recommended treatments before anything goes ahead.
We use modern digital imaging where required to get a clear and accurate view of your teeth and gums.
A high-precision scan of your teeth that gives a detailed digital map of your mouth, without the need for messy, traditional impressions. It’s complimentary at your new patient check-up.
I’m nervous about the dentist. Can you help?
Yes. Let us know when you book and our team will take time to understand your history and talk you through your options. Sedation is available from £350.
Monday and Wednesday 8:45am to 7pm, Tuesday, Thursday and Friday 8:45am to 5pm, and Saturday 8:45am to 4:30pm.
Yes. Membership plans start from £11.25 a month and spread the cost of your routine check-ups and hygiene visits.
MK Smiles is at Brooklands Health Centre, 42 Montague Crescent, Brooklands, Milton Keynes MK10 7LN.
